final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: IREF (~10uA) into NMOS diode, 10 long/narrow unit devices (low gm, low 1/f)
M0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=2 m=10
* PMOS common-source gain stage, low-noise NMOS mirror load (~18uA)
M1 vb iin vdd vdd pfet W=30 L=0.5
* level-shift resistor: vb sits ~0.36V above va (feedback node)
Rd vb va 20k
M2 va ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=2 m=18
* shunt feedback resistor (raised for lower thermal noise / higher Zt)
Rf iin va 390k
* NMOS source-follower output buffer (~5uA), gate on shifted node vb
M3 vdd vb vout vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M4 vout ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=2 m=5
.ends
